# BEIR NFCorpus

*Generated by `scripts/gen_bench_pages.py` from the `oml-bench/1` results in `eval/bench/results/`; do not edit by hand. Regenerate with `python scripts/gen_bench_pages.py`, and CI fails when this page differs from what it writes.*

Suite `beir-nfcorpus`, data `beir/nfcorpus/test (ir_datasets 0.6.3)`: 3,633 memories, 323 queries; a method marked sampled asked a seeded subset, named in its row. Measured 2026-11-05 on commit `d3fdb72`; build release, host 8 vCPU / 15 GB, postgres 17.9.

[All suites](index.md)

## Limits of this run

- Offline bm25s over the same memories (Lucene BM25, English stop words, Snowball stems), not a served path; One abstract per memory as '<title>. <text>' (BEIR indexes two fields); k 100, no token budget; English only.
- One abstract per memory as '<title>. <text>' (BEIR indexes two fields); k 100, no token budget; English only. Known gap: served bm25 measures below BEIR's published 0.325 and Pyserini's single-field 0.322; the offline textbook BM25 over the same memories measures 0.318, so most of the gap is the one-body mapping and the analyser (Snowball against Lucene's Porter, hyphenated words kept whole), not the ranking (ADR-0049 d12).

Sources: `eval/bench/results/beir-nfcorpus/keyword-all.json`, `eval/bench/results/beir-nfcorpus/keyword-any.json`, `eval/bench/results/beir-nfcorpus/bm25.json`, `eval/bench/results/beir-nfcorpus/bm25-trigram.json`, `eval/bench/results/beir-nfcorpus/reference-bm25s-k1-0.9-b-0.4.json`, `eval/bench/results/beir-nfcorpus/reference-bm25s-k1-1.2-b-0.75.json`.
